name: Sika Film

SIKA® FILM: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: Sika® Film, April 2023, Version 01.03 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/c/sika_film.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide Sika® Film where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.03).
1.2 Product description. Sika® Film is a 1-part liquid concentrate which controls the moisture evaporation from the freshly cast concrete flatwork surface in addition to functioning as a finishing aid.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer.
    - All applications where a superior finish is required on concrete flatwork
    - Protects concrete from the effects of excessive moisture loss in rapid drying conditions
1.4 Limits of use. Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.6.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. Sika® Film
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: Evaporation Control and Finishing Aid liquid concentrate
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Approvals, certificates and standards stated by the manufacturer. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (April 2023, Version 01.03) has no approvals, certificates or standards section.
2.3 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - Eliminates the need to add water to low slump concrete or spraying water on the concrete surface to aid finishing
    - Good finishing aid to fresh concrete for extra smooth and durable concrete floors
    - Reduces plastic shrinkage cracking caused by evaporation in low humidity conditions such as heat and high winds
    - Finishing aid to fresh concrete that produces little or no bleed water, such as microsilica or air entrained mixes
2.4 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Appearance and colour: Blue liquid
    - Density: 1.0 kg/litre approximately
2.5 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: 10 litre pail; 205 litre drum
    - Shelf life: 24 months from date of production
    - Storage conditions: The product must be stored in original, unopened and undamaged sealed packaging in dry conditions at temperatures between +5 °C and +35 °C. Always refer to packaging.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 Substrate preparation. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (April 2023, Version 01.03) states no substrate preparation requirements.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.03) and the requirements below.
4.2 Consumption. When diluted at a ratio of 1:8, 1 litre of Sika® Film will yield 9 litres of liquid.Depending on surface profile and texture the total diluted material covers an area of approximately 35-90 m². These figures are theoretical and do not allow for any additional material due to surface porosity, surface profile, variations in level or wastage etc. Dosage rates outside the recommended range may be used when project conditions require special consideration. Contact Sika Technical Services for additional information.
4.3 Application.
    - Dilution
    - Thoroughly mix 1 part Sika® Film with 8 parts of water by volume.
4.4 Application - Finishing Aid. Apply the diluted Sika® Film solution with a fine mist sprayer as soon as possible after placing concrete and before floating and trowelling operations.
4.5 Application - Evaporation Control. Apply the diluted Sika® Film solution with a fine mist sprayer as soon as possible after floating and trowelling operations.
4.6 Limitations and important considerations.
    - Sika® Film is NOT a curing compound.
    - Sika® Film does not adversely affect the surface hardness of concrete, when applied at the recommended coverage rate.
    - Sika® Film can be used with concrete containing retarding, accelerating, water reducing or superplasti-cising admixtures.
    For additional information, please contact your local Sika® Representative.
4.7 Further information. It is recommended that a dilution of 1:5 (Sika® Film:Water) be used for very low humidity and windy condition.

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, confirm the site conditions with the manufacturer. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Conditions to be verified. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (April 2023, Version 01.03) lists no application condition limits.
5.3 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.4 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: Sika® Film, April 2023, Version 01.03, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/c/sika_film.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: Sika Film, version 25/07/2025, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/w/MSDS%20Sika%C2%AE%20Film%20GHS7.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. For information and advice on the safe handling, storage and disposal of chemical products, users shall refer to the most recent Safety Data Sheet (SDS) containing physical, ecological, toxicological and other safety-related data.
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.1, and include the records in the project documentation.
